items.title: MECH-324 falsifier (a) rapid reacquisition: dissolve a crystallised chunk, re-present the regime, measure repetitions-to-re-formation against R_min (retention ON/OFF x f_reacq sweep x window length)
items.note: MECH-324 relapse falsifier (a) RAPID REACQUISITION -- the one falsifier of the three testable against the operator as it stands. Dissolve a crystallised chunk, re-present the same consistent above-baseline regime, count repetitions-to-re-formation. Substrate: ree-v3 6c3e67e5d3 (use_chunk_dissolution_retention, default OFF; chunk_reacquisition_repetition_factor 0.25). Claim registration: REE_assembly 0ffe3da26a. Parent cluster ARC-071 (recorded as parent_claim_id, deliberately NOT tagged: that claim is about chunks changing BEHAVIOUR via the proposal pool, and proposal injection is absent here). ARMS (11): retention OFF/ON x f_reacq {1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1} x window_trials W {30, 100}, plus one MILD-dissolution robustness arm. DV = r_reacq, post-dissolution repetitions to revival, censored at 250. C1 (LOAD-BEARING) median r_reacq < median measured r_acq AND < R_min; C2 Spearman rho(f_reacq, r_reacq) >= 0.8; C3 retention discriminates erasure (OFF never revives, ON does). Overall PASS = C1 AND C2 AND C3. C4/C5 reported, not gating. OPERATOR-LEVEL DRIVER, NOT AN AGENT RUN -- deliberate: V3-EXQ-810 measured the accumulator SILENT under agent control (c1_form_seed_frac 0.333, label chunk_accumulator_silent), so an agent-level reacquisition run would measure that readiness gap rather than MECH-324. Falsifier (a) is a claim about the FORMATION-THRESHOLD operator, so the operator is the correct unit of analysis. DESIGN-AUDIT FINDING carried into the manifest regardless of outcome (custom_information.unit_scale_dissolution_unreachable): MECH-323 specifies outcome variance on a 0-1 normalised scale, but max attainable POPULATION variance on a span-S range is S^2/4 = 0.25 on the unit scale, BELOW the F_high = 0.45 dissolution gate -- so on the claim's own specified scale CRYSTALLISED -> DISSOLVING is ARITHMETICALLY UNREACHABLE and the whole relapse-falsifier family (a)/(b)/(c) has no entry point at the pre-registered defaults. Resolved by pre-registering the harness OUTCOME_SPAN = 2.0 (max variance 1.0); F_low 0.15 and F_high 0.45 are BOTH left at their claim defaults and NEITHER is lowered. Emitted as the precondition dissolution_variance_reachable so a reader can recompute it. VERDICT-ALIASING CONTROL: the W axis exists so a FAIL can distinguish 'the quantitative prediction is wrong' from 'it is masked by the window length'. Reaching DISSOLVED requires T_dissolve = 50 trials of supra-F_high variance, so at W = 100 at least half the variance window is necessarily contaminated at dissolution -- structural, not driver-specific (the MILD arm checks that empirically). DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, all 11): DV is an ordered stopping time; retention toggles the revival code path, f_reacq sets the threshold on the counter the DV measures, W sets the variance window length. None is a broadcast constant under an argmax DV, a monotone rescaling under a rank DV, or a permutation under a set-aggregate DV -- no manipulation is invariant. The one arithmetic-identity risk (r_reacq == ceil(R_min * f_reacq)) is TESTED not assumed: r_reacq_minus_forced_bar is recorded per cell and C2 is marked degenerate if every cell sits exactly on its forced bar. CAVEATS (registered, load-bearing): f_reacq = 0.25 is an UNCALIBRATED ENGINEERING DEFAULT on the same footing as F_high = 0.45 -- both sources establish reacquisition is much faster, NEITHER quantifies how much, so this tests DIRECTION and SCALING, never the value. TRANSFER LIMIT: grounding is Barnes 2005 (Nature 10.1038/nature04053, rodent T-maze procedural learning) and Bouton 2012 (Behav Processes 10.1016/j.beproc.2012.03.004, single-response operant contingencies); in both the extinguished object is FAR simpler than a multi-element composed chunked primitive, so whether a SEQUENCE extinguishes with the same asymmetry is EXTRAPOLATION, NOT EVIDENCE. NOT CONFLATED with falsifier (b) renewal: REE_assembly fb29f0bdf8 REFUSED that build (initiation_set is declared-but-never-populated -- both mint() call sites omit it, zero reads repo-wide), which does not affect (a), needing no context machinery. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is r_reacq (post-dissolution repetitions to re-formation); grepped every manifest in REE_assembly/evidence/experiments for 'reacquisition' -- ZERO hits, and the substrate landed 2026-07-27, after every recorded run -> not recoverable, run it. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: count 1 for each of MECH-324 / MECH-323 (failure_autopsy_backlog_2026-07-24 only), below the threshold of 2 -- brake does not fire. ARM REUSE: cells fingerprinted with the DEFAULT include_driver_script_in_hash=True, i.e. deliberately NOT minted for cross-driver reuse -- a cell is milliseconds of pure-python and trains nothing, so the reuse surface has no value while an excluded-driver hash without a canonical baseline module would carry real false-HIT risk. Stated judgement, not an omission. machine_affinity 'any' is the cloud-preferring setting (the only value in use; the scaler powers cloud workers on for claimable work and they claim ahead of the Mac). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths: OK, 0 warnings on every check. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 1 seed x 11 arms, 1.8s): ran end-to-end, dry-run manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/ by emit_outcome, per-cell arm_fingerprint + always-core present, 66-verdict accounting consistent with seeds x conditions. AUTHORING PROBE (disclosed; thresholds were taken verbatim from the claim's falsifier text and NOT tuned to it): the smoke reproduced r_reacq = 28 / 90 at W = 30 / 100, FLAT across all four f_reacq values, r_reacq/W = 0.908 +/- 0.029, retention-OFF never reviving, and r_acq = 20 = R_min exactly -- i.e. BOTH legs of the FALSIFIED condition fire while C3 holds, self-routing retention_real_but_rapid_reacquisition_falsified. That expected direction is NOT a reason to redesign until it passes: a falsifier that falsifies is the instrument working.

items.title: SD-082 head-internals diagnostic: root-cause the still-zero V3-EXQ-822a propagation_non_vacuity via hidden_dead_relu_frac / rule_summary_magnitude_ratio
items.note: PUSH-HOLD (IMPORTANT): this script requires REEConfig.lateral_pfc_capture_head_diagnostics, landed ONLY in the still-unpushed SD-082 AMEND commits (ree-v3 63267dcf5d, REE_assembly 19955cf795 -- held by the clinical-hours push guard as of 2026-07-27T14:xx, WORKSPACE_STATE 2026-07-27T08:59Z entry). Both this commit and the AMEND commits must reach origin/main BEFORE this entry is POSTed to the coordinator (Step 8.6 atomicity rule) -- do NOT POST until confirmed on origin, or a cloud worker will claim an entry whose script crashes with an unknown REEConfig kwarg. User instruction 2026-07-27: queue + commit locally now, push everything together once off-duty. EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic (root-cause probe, NOT a re-test of SD-078 -- excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). Routed by failure_autopsy_batch-822a-826-817a-827_2026-07-26 Section 2 (confirmed): V3-EXQ-822a re-ran 822 with the SD-082 read-out consumer correctly engaged and a strong upstream chain (on_rule_state_diff_mean 0.644) but readiness gate (d) propagation_non_vacuity STILL failed at exactly 0.0 on both arms -- the second consecutive identical failure. The SD-082 AMEND landed LateralPFCConfig.capture_head_diagnostics (no-op default, bit-identical-when-on) to record hidden_dead_relu_frac + rule_summary_magnitude_ratio via get_state(); this run is the amend's own named follow-on to actually root-cause the dead-ReLU/insensitivity hypothesis in rule_bias_head's untouched first Linear+ReLU layer. Structurally IDENTICAL to 822a (same 2 arms x 3 seeds x P0=60/P1=70/P2=40 schedule, same env, same seeds 101/202/303) -- a controlled instrumentation-only replication, not a new manipulation -- with lateral_pfc_capture_head_diagnostics=True added on BOTH arms (both train their own bias head in P1, so both are 'trained arms'). Reads hidden_dead_relu_frac/rule_summary_magnitude_ratio immediately after the REAL-rule_state compute_bias() call inside the propagation counterfactual, BEFORE the zeroed-rule_state counterfactual call overwrites the latched fields (same latch-ordering hazard class as e3_selector.last_*); also snapshots the four always-fresh (non-latched) weight-norm fields at init/post_p0/post_p1/post_p2 phase boundaries. Readiness mirrors 822a's gates (a) cone present (b) ON pool differentiated (c) ON rule active, PLUS two new gates (e) head-diagnostics capture positive-control (config echo + finiteness on a synthetic init probe) (f) P2 diagnostic sample sufficiency (worst-cell >=5); 822a's gate (d) propagation_non_vacuity is deliberately NOT gating here (it is the target phenomenon being diagnosed, not a precondition for the diagnosis). Load-bearing C1_head_diagnostics_interpretable = readiness (a,b,c,e,f) all met -- PASS means the probe produced an interpretable finding regardless of which hypothesis it confirms. Interpretation routes to dead_relu_confirmed_root_cause / head_untrained_last_layer_static / magnitude_imbalance_confirmed_contributor / propagation_vacuity_unexplained_by_head_internals, all component booleans recorded in diagnostic_flags (not mutually exclusive, not hidden behind the priority-ordered label). GOV-REUSE-1: grepped evidence/experiments/*.json for hidden_dead_relu_frac / rule_summary_magnitude_ratio -- zero hits (the fields did not exist before this session's own SD-082 AMEND) -> not recoverable, run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: both prior SD-078 autopsies (816c-822, batch-822a-826-817a-827) carry re_derive_brake.fired=False in their own artifacts -- categories precondition_unmet / competence_implementation_gap, neither substrate_ceiling under R3 -- brake does not fire; independently exempt regardless as a diagnostic discriminating WHY the gate fails. Substrate readiness: lateral_pfc_capture_head_diagnostics confirmed 3-site-plumbed (LateralPFCConfig field, REEConfig.from_dims signature+assignment, agent.py getattr-fallback build) in the local ree-v3 working tree (grep-verified). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings (added module-level ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT for the head_diagnostics_capture_active precondition -- a config echo reachable by construction, not a tuned scoring predicate). Smoke PASS (--dry-run, P0/P1/P2=3/3/3 eps, 1 seed): ran end-to-end no crashes, dry-run manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/ by emit_outcome, always-core (recording_schema/substrate_hash/machine/machine_class/elapsed_seconds/config/seeds) + per-cell arm_fingerprint confirmed present, head_diag_by_phase populated at all 4 boundaries with finite in-range values, correctly self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue on the (expected, toy-scale) P2 sample-starvation gate.

items.title: INV-091: cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier, remaining 5 ablations (event broadcasts / mode conditioning / residue feedback / randomised rates / harm-stream collapse)
items.note: Complements V3-EXQ-827/827a (INV-091 cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier), which already exercised landmark removal (DECOUPLE) and forced lockstep (LOCKSTEP) -- both self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue. This run exercises the remaining FIVE of the claim's seven named ablations on the SAME shared-warmed-substrate-per-seed design and infra (stream_recorder, trace_store, q081_profile, q081_surrogate, arm_fingerprint -- no infra rebuilt): BROADCAST_OFF (toggles agent.hippocampal.config.use_invalidation_trigger=False for the eval window -- MECH-287 ONLY, distinct from 827/827a's landmark-removal arm which hits MECH-269/287/288 together; boundary events and use_anchor_sets untouched), MODE_DECORRELATED (patches agent.salience.tick to feed it independent per-tick noise instead of the real dacc_bundle/drive_level, NOT use_salience_coordinator=False which would null the operating_mode stream outright), RESIDUE_OFF (forces hypothesis_tag=True on every agent.update_residue call, reusing MECH-094's own accumulation-block mechanism), RATE_RANDOMIZED (resamples agent.clock.e2_steps_per_tick / _e3_base_steps fresh every episode from pre-registered ranges (1,6)/(3,18), breaking the fixed 1:3:10 phase relationship without forcing synchrony either extreme), HARM_COLLAPSE (patches agent.latent_stack.encode to overwrite the returned LatentState's z_harm_a with a truncated slice of that SAME call's z_harm -- adds a 5th similarity pair (z_harm, z_harm_a) to the statistic specifically for this arm; its movement on that ONE pair is BY CONSTRUCTION per design, analogous to how 827a's lockstep is constructed to move via forced tick synchrony -- overall C1/C2 still require the pooled 5-pair mean and the other 4 (unrelated) pairs to move for real). C1/C2 REDESIGNED for 6 arms (N-arm generalisation of 827/827a's bipolar 3-arm shape, since these 5 ablations do not admit a clean pre-registered direction the way landmark-removal/lockstep did): C1 = at least one ablation moves mean similarity away from intact by >= SIMILARITY_MOVE_FLOOR (claim's own literal non-degeneracy wording, applied across the full 6-arm set rather than one pre-chosen pair). C2 = the empirical peak-composite arm is INTERIOR (neither the empirical similarity min nor max across all 6 arms) and beats both empirical extremes by >= COMPOSITE_MARGIN (generalises 'intact beats both extremes' to an arbitrary similarity ranking; a secondary non-load-bearing diagnostic still reports whether intact specifically beats both extremes for continuity with 827/827a). Thresholds unchanged from 827/827a (SIMILARITY_MOVE_FLOOR=0.02, COMPOSITE_MARGIN=0.15) -- properties of the DVs, not of which manipulations produced them. DV-SYMMETRY: none of the 5 manipulations is a broadcast-scalar/monotone-rescaling symmetry invariant by construction; full per-arm declaration in the script's module docstring, including the HARM_COLLAPSE construction-effect caveat above. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: INV-091 has exactly 1 prior autopsy (failure_autopsy_batch-822a-826-817a-827_2026-07-26), below the >=2 threshold and targeting an instrument defect (827's confounded lockstep construction) that would not count toward the brake even at a higher tally; this run tests 5 DIFFERENT manipulations 827/827a never touched, so it is not a re-derive of that autopsy's target regardless. GOV-REUSE-1: reanalysis_query.py --claim INV-091 (2026-07-27) returns only V3-EXQ-827/827a (different substrate_hash from each other), neither carrying any of these 5 ablations or the (z_harm, z_harm_a) pair -- not recoverable, first run. Substrate readiness: all 5 mechanisms (SD-032a salience coordinator, MECH-094 residue tagging, SD-006 multi-rate clock, SD-010/SD-011 harm streams, MECH-287 invalidation trigger) are already live/IMPLEMENTED substrate used across many prior experiments incl. 827/827a themselves -- no substrate gap. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2 warmup/2 eval eps/20 steps): all 6 arms x 3 seeds ran end-to-end with no crashes; toy-scale run happened to clear both criteria (PASS, not scientifically meaningful at this scale, mirrors the expectation that dry-run outcomes are structural checks only). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings. validate_recording.py --strict on the dry-run manifest: OK, always-core complete. A synthesis of INV-091's evidence must read this manifest ALONGSIDE V3-EXQ-827a's, not in isolation -- together they span all 7 named ablations across two runs.
